早寝早起きさん、こんにちは！あなたの絵は本当に素晴らしいです。可能であれば、私のオリジナルキャラクターのイラストの依頼を送りたいです。

◼︎ アウレリアン
身長：161cm
髪：茶髪、前髪はセンターパート
目：上半分が紫、下半分がソフトピンクの異色目。
オーレリアンは冷酷でありながらエレガントな女王で、深紅とゴールドのドレープをまとい、ゴシック調の玉座の間から畏怖と恐怖を指揮している。笏を手に、血のように赤い薔薇の冠をかぶった彼女は、美と権力の両方を体現している。輝く微笑みの下には、鋭く、狡猾で、手出しのできない戦略家が潜んでいる。

彼女の服装は、既存の3種類の中から自由に選ぶことも、新たに着せ替えることもできます。また、ポーズや表情も、彼女の威厳と狡猾さが表現されていれば、自由に決めていただいて結構です。

お忙しい中、本当にありがとうございました！

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ok-_F8QCDQm3CHFlgA3a7Xdj5p0kGML8?usp=sharing

早寝早起き先生こんばんは！
いつもイラスト楽しく拝見させていただいております！

早寝早起き先生の描かれる、バシバシまつ毛の強い顔と、ムチムチかわいいボディ、そしておしゃれ！！の画風のバランスがめちゃくちゃ好きです！！

是非、拙作の『のあ先輩はともだち。』のヒロイン・のあ先輩をお願いできればと思います…！！
(※編集さんから許可いただいてます)

↓のアドレスから1巻分が読めます。

早寝早起き先生の世界観全開でご自由にお描きいただければと思います。
どうぞよろしくお願い致します！！

こんにちは！ 

あなたの画風がとても好きなので、私のVTuberのイラストをお願いしたいです！ 彼女は不器用で優しいウサギの看護師です。 彼女を自由に、好きなように描いていただけたらと思います。 構図、表情、ポーズはお任せします。

よろしくお願いします！

https://toyhou.se/17992622.nurse-ambi/21425141.main-reference

Please excuse my request...❣️
Just to be sure 🦆 excuse me 💕

Contents.
Illustration of a man and a woman with white hair. Illustration of a man and a woman with white hair(?)
Signature of Ochasama

Character
A woman
She is a girl, but she is a man's daughter.
She has white twin-tail hair and pale purple eyes.
She is a 21 year old girl who hates people. She doesn't really talk to anyone except her childhood friends, so people tend to think she's a kind person.
I like to dress up more than I like to look like a girl, and I like to be who I want to be, whether it's cute or cool.

Man
Male girl, when the above girl is dressed up as a man.
I have short gray hair and pale purple eyes.

Please refer to the attached documents.

Composition
I mainly imagine them as a pair in a mirror.
I'm mainly imagining a pair of girls through a mirror, but you can draw it any way you like 💕.
The image can be either gothic or cute, so you can do whatever you want. ❣️
If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. If you are not able to make it in time, please sign our autograph! I will cry if you sign it 😭Please do so ......🥹

[Attire.
We will be wearing matching purple bunny outfits for men and women (information attached).
I'm sure you'll be able to find a way to get a good deal on a new pair of shoes. If you have any suggestions, please let us know. If you have any questions, please feel free to change it. 🙆🏻

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/j76y0xv6mknger0d805aq/h?dl=0&rlkey=phvgyb70zsxplxs3ojanrqdz7

Good evening Ocha! My name is Natsu!

I would like to make a request to Ocha-san for a commission.
Thank you very much.

I would like to request an illustration of Coteca from the perspective of her partner!

Cat cafe (interior and background are fine, just set it indoors!) A girl is holding a cat (a brown tiger) in her arms.

I wasn't sure I could convey the message in a real hurry, so I took the composition using my friend as the subject now: ！！！！！！ (Please refer to the file)

Think of the backpack as a cat, and the cat and the coteacher are facing each other. ......

Your face should look like you are smiling with your mouth open ( ;)!


Clothes should be like the image in the file (I'm not particular about it).

I also put the material of Kotecha in the file...(ᐡᴗ ᴗᐡ) The bottom two pictures are drawn by my favorite guess artist... The expression below is very ideal, so please make the smile like this! ...🫠👐🤍🤍🤍🥩.


I hope we have the pleasure of meeting you!!!

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/lp4m7ny3jcyb6r7/AABHAM7Duw-8TEMOgQYDrX0Xa?dl=0

Hi Ocha-san, I have been looking at your wonderful illustrations for a long time and was notified that you had opened a sketchbook, so I sent it to you.
If you have opened it by mistake, you can cancel it.

The following are the details.
Requests ￤ 2 creative boys
The material of the appearance is included in the URL, so we would be happy if you could refer to it.
Although they are not listed in the appearance, we would like both of them to wear chemo-ear.
The one with white hair should be a white rabbit with drooping ears and the one with brown hair should be a wolf.

Next, the composition should be as if the white-haired girl is being licked by the brown-haired girl.
The white-haired girl looks surprised and teary-eyed, and the brown-haired girl looks happy.
I would also like the white-haired girl to look neutral and more like a girl.
We will leave the scope of depiction up to you.

We would like to leave the clothing to you.
We would be happy if you could draw them as you like.

If possible, I would also like to have a background in a bedroom or living room.

We apologize for the sketchy nature of our requests.
I love Ocha-san's sense of style, so I would be very happy if you could draw it the way you like.

I thought it might be good to mention that there are no landmines or anything that I don't like being drawn, so don't worry about it and do what you want. Please do not hesitate to do what you want with it. ......!
I apologize for the length of this article, but I will briefly describe my personality at the end.

White-haired girl ￤Mature personality with a lot of emotionless expression
Brown-haired child ￤ friendly and cheerful personality like a dog whose facial expression changes from one moment to the next.
Basically, it seems that the white-haired girl is always being pushed around by the brown-haired girl.

These are the details.
We apologize if there are any parts that are difficult to understand, but we would appreciate your consideration.
We hope you will have a wonderful relationship with Ocha-san.

おちゃさん〜リクエスト失礼致します❤️

コテちゃんの単体で、構図的にはお相手様目線で女の子に向かって伸ばしたお相手様の手と、女の子はお相手様に向かって抱きつこうと両手を広げているに感じでお相手様の腕だけ描いて頂き匂わせ風イラストにして頂きたいです！お相手様はスーツ姿です(https://linksharing.samsungcloud.com/fduVS21Excpv)
コテちゃん(https://linksharing.samsungcloud.com/wI6DgfBh4ILM)は茶髪から下にかけて紫になっていくグラデーションカラー、淡いグレーの瞳の女の子です。見た目は綺麗系の子だけどお相手様が大好きで大好き仕方なくてずーっとぴったりくっついていたい、とっても可愛い女の子なんです…！右腕には蘭の花のタトゥー(イメージはこんな感じです→https://linksharing.samsungcloud.com/kX51cllf75l0)が入っていて、セクシー系のドレス(今回はこちらのドレス→https://linksharing.samsungcloud.com/ml4rfW1CtYLd で、色を同系の紫に変更お願い致します💦)を好んできています。おっぱいの大きい子なのでおちゃさんにおっぱい描いて頂けるのがとっても楽しみです…(？？)ぜひぜひよろしくお願い致します😭💕
